The old wording described a mechanism that could not be built, which is worse than an unmet obligation: it would have been 'satisfied' by a launcher that called nothing and reported success. ⚠️ WHAT IS TRUE INSTEAD, and all of it is enforceable. The launcher owns ONE child: the `next start` process. The change-stream service owns its watcher and closes it when its last subscriber leaves — already built and tested under TSK-0011. Terminating the application process releases any watcher still open through process teardown, which is the operating system's guarantee rather than the launcher's. `close()` stays what it is: a service and test lifecycle operation, never something the launcher claims to call across a process boundary. ⚠️ THIS COMPONENT'S DESIGN WORK SHRANK RATHER THAN GREW. Its notes called 'choosing and validating the binding' the substance of the component; there is no binding to choose. What is left is a real and checkable job: one command, an absolute content root printed at startup, loopback bound explicitly, shutdown forwarded, the child waited for, and a bounded escalation if it does not go. ⚠️ BUILT 2026-08-29 BY TSK-0013 (EVD-0073). ACC-0032 and ACC-0033 pass. ⚠️ IT OWNS ONE CHILD AND SAYS SO. `next start` is spawned directly with Node, so the pid it holds IS the server's — through `npm run` it would hold a shim, and on Windows a `.cmd` shim whose child does not reliably receive a forwarded signal. ⚠️ THE CONTENT ROOT IS ABSOLUTE AND PRINTED, and a missing one is exit code 2 rather than a fallback. The application would otherwise resolve to its own directory and be correct with no way for the operator to know WHICH directory — #70's refusal-to-guess at the launcher. ⚠️ ITS RUN DIRECTORY EXISTS PARTLY SO CLEANUP CAN BE OBSERVED. It carries the run record a supervisor reads to find the child; its removal is one of ACC-0032's three observations, and a launcher with no temporary state would make that clause vacuous. ⚠️ ACC-0033 RE-EVALUATED 2026-08-29 (EVD-0074) after being marked `pass` on evidence that disclaimed the install branch. It now rests on a cold run: no `node_modules`, no `.next`, install branch taken and asserted, content root verified to be inside the copy rather than the source repository.
responsibility: Install and run the shell from one documented command: build the application and start it in production mode, owning the `next start` process as a child, forwarding shutdown to it, waiting for it to exit, and leaving nothing behind — no process on the port, no temporary directory it created. The file watcher is an in-process resource of the child and is released by its teardown.
